Hi team — thanks for the context. Plan below:

1) NDA: We have a standard mutual NDA we can send today. I will draft and send to Sara for signature. Target turnaround: 1-3 business days.

2) DPA/MSA: We will request ACME's DPA template. We can review in parallel but sequencing depends on how many redlines ACME proposes. Typical internal target for first-pass redlines: 5-10 business days. If ACME provides only minor redlines, we can turn faster (3-5 days).

3) Redline priorities we will focus on: data residency, audit rights, liability caps, and security incident notification timelines. For enterprise MSAs we typically push to limit liability and define clear support/SLA language; I will flag non-starters early.

4) Routing: NDA -> technical scoping -> MSA/DPA concurrent review -> procurement SOW/PO. We should plan to have Connor share SOW language by EOD so procurement has something to slot in.

I’ll send the NDA to Sara now and will set expectations on turn times.
